owner.name: Nate Cordero
owner.bio: Nate Cordero started running wire as an apprentice on new-construction crews around the Treasure Valley, then spent a decade doing service work — the calls where something's already broken and somebody's waiting on you to fix it. Voltridge Electric is the one-van operation he always wanted: he answers his own phone, quotes the job before he starts, and doesn't leave a panel looking like a spider built it.

faq.a: Yes — any job that requires one gets a permit pulled and inspected. It's part of doing it right, not an upsell.

faq.q: How do I know if my panel needs an upgrade?
faq.a: Breakers that trip for no clear reason, warm or discolored outlets, flickering lights when something big kicks on, or a fuse box instead of breakers — any of those is worth a look.

faq.q: How long does an EV charger install take?
faq.a: Most installs are same-day — usually two to four hours once we're on site, depending on how far the panel is from where the charger goes.
For active hazards — sparking, burning smell, a dead panel — yes, call and we'll work you in. Routine issues get scheduled at the next normal slot.

faq.q: Is the service call fee separate from the repair cost?
faq.a: The service call covers the first hour of diagnostic time. If you move forward with the repair that day, it's applied toward the total — you're not paying twice.
